question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%overpotential%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%nucleation%' ORDER BY page, id
